protocol.comparison: Unchanged raw Int64 array versus managed PolyArray<Int64>; allocations excluded, checked native indexing retained. Not an isolated measure of type-parameter overhead.

workloads.Comparison: Mono is the unchanged raw Int64 CJR array; Poly is PolyArray<Int64> using managed storage with bounds checks. Ratios include representation and compiler differences, not just type parameters.
workloads.array_read: One permuted indexed read per element, initialized before timing.
workloads.array_write_read: One permuted write plus one sequential read per element; reported ns/op divides by twice the length.
workloads.Protocol: Three processes, seven alternating samples each, independently calibrated towards 20 ms; checksums checked. Allocation, initialization and cleanup are excluded.
